_comment: Curated research-extracted tier data for the otherwise pending-extraction --match criteria, merged into _match-index.json by scripts/render-match-index.py. ONLY criteria with a STORED, citable per-country signal in the repo belong here. The other pending criteria — safety / connectivity / yield / climate / cost-of-living — have NO stored per-country value (they are computed live/per-query from primary sources by design, so they never go stale); pre-baking them would decay or fabricate, so they stay pending. Every band here cites its source + the verbatim evidence phrase; bands are coarse tiers (no false precision). See _local/scope-match-section.md § Phase 2.

healthcare.metric: public-system enrollment timeline for a working-age resident — faster statutory access = higher band (NOT a care-quality measure)
healthcare.note: Only the countries with an EXPLICIT enrollment timeline in the source are tiered. Countries with vaguer 'access on tax-residency registration' wording (e.g. IT SSN, PT SNS) and AU (nationality-conditional Reciprocal Health Care Agreement) are intentionally omitted — they stay pending rather than be force-tiered.
